learning_outcomes.text: Designs the mechanical elements using a methodical approach.
Assets the stress, deflection and strength of a machine element.
Designs machines for static and variable loadings.
Calculates the fatigue strength for mechanical components.

syllabus_topics: Stress components, Mohr Circles, triaxial stress
Singularity functions, curved members in flexure, contact stress
Tension, compression and torsion, finding deflection by integration.
Strain energy, Castigliano's theorem and columns
Failure resulting from variable loading, modifying factors and notch sensitivity
Combinations of loading modes, cumulative fatigue damage
Force analysis for gears and flexible mechanical elements
bibliography: Norton, R.L., "Machine Design: An Integrated Approach"
Babalik, Fatih C., "Machine Elements and Construction Examples"
Richard G. Budynas, J. Keith Nisbett, "Shigley's Mechanical Engineering Design" Translation from 8th Edition in SI Units, Editors: H.S.Ergül, Y.Pancar, Literatür Publishing.
